sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Virgin Polyethylene and Polypropylene Granules

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (as amended in 2003)
Agreement between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Singapore on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments
Trilateral Investment Agreement among the Government of the People's Republic of China, the Government of Japan and the Government of the Republic of Korea
Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (RCEP, in force for China on 1 January 2022)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 - Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (effective 1 November 2024); PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (2024 revision, effective 1 January 2025); PBOC Measures for Anti-Money Laundering Customer Due Diligence and Transaction Record Management (2016); PRC Counter-Terrorism Law; State Council Decree No. 746 on Market Entity Registration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of foreign investor (certified true copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar / companies registry in the investor's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague path: notarize the certificate in the origin country, obtain an Apostille from the origin country's competent authority, then arrange certified Chinese translation; non-Hague path: notarize the certificate, authenticate it by the origin country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then apply for Consular Legalization at the PRC Embassy or Consulate, then arrange certified Chinese translation. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Active Status
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar of the investor's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For Apostille Convention countries: issue -> notarization -> apostille -> certified Chinese translation; for non-member countries: issue -> notarization -> foreign ministry authentication -> consular legalization at PRC Embassy/Consulate -> certified Chinese translation. The document must be issued within 90 days before submission.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing WFOE formation and bank account opening
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor's board of directors / corporate secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize signatures in origin; then apostille (Hague) or consular legalization (non-Hague); then arrange certified Chinese translation. Banks usually require the same legalization path as the corporate bundle. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive and must not be sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum of Association / Constitutional documents of foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered corporate service provider or company registrar in origin country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy + notarization + apostille/consular legalization + certified Chinese translation. For Hague states use apostille; for non-Hague states use foreign ministry authentication and PRC consular legalization; no chain of both procedures.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor's relationship bank in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-issued letter -> notarization of branch signature if demanded -> apostille/consular legalization -> certified Chinese translation. Direct bank-to-bank confirmation may bypass legalization only if the receiving PRC bank explicitly accepts an unlegalized original.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Register of Directors and UBOs of foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar or registered agent in origin country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issue -> notarize -> apostille (Hague) or consular legalization (non-Hague) -> certified Chinese translation. This document supports UBO identification; if unavailable, a notarized UBO declaration from each shareholder is acceptable.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, UK OFSI sanctions list, PRC MOFCOM and MFA sanctions lists, and domestic terrorist organization lists under the PRC Counter-Terrorism Law. All shareholders, UBOs, directors, senior managers, signatories, and intermediaries must be screened before incorporation and again before each SWIFT LC payment. PEP status is assessed for foreign senior officials, domestic officials, international organization executives, family members and close associates; source of wealth and funds must be documented for petrochemical trading entities. Adverse media, corporate registry cross-checks and network analysis are required. Any hit requires internal escalation, enhanced due diligence and an STR to CAMLMAC within 24 hours.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR Enterprise Name Self-Declaration System / China National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform, administered by the State Administration for Market Regulation and the local Administration for Market Regulation where the WFOE will be domiciled
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Chinese statutory name must be in simplified Chinese and follow the four-tier structure: administrative division + distinctive name + industry/operating characteristics + organization form. A WFOE must end with 'Limited Liability' in English and the corresponding Chinese statutory expression for a limited liability company. The distinctive name may be a phonetic/pinyin transliteration of the investor's English name; Mandarin pinyin is accepted; traditional Chinese characters and standalone English names are not a valid registered name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: China / Zhongguo / Zhonghua / Guojia / Zhongyang / Quanguo
People's Liberation Army / Zhongguo Renmin Jiefangjun
Communist Party of China / Zhongguo Gongchandang
Group / Jituan (requires group enterprise approval or parent group use)
International / Guoji (only if supported by planned cross-border business and subject to review)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is automatically valid for 30 days. The applicant may extend once for an additional 30 days before expiry by submitting the same application in the portal. If the name is rejected, the applicant should analyze the rejection code, correct the distinctive element, and submit a new name declaration immediately. A formal refusal may be appealed to the Market Regulation Administration at the next higher level within 60 days of notice under the Administrative Reconsideration Law; the appeal must state the legal basis, cite the non-conflicting search results, and attach all clearance documents. If the reconsideration is unsuccessful, an administrative lawsuit may be brought in the people's court within six months.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or postal mailbox is not acceptable as the registered office of a WFOE in the wholesale petrochemical polymer distribution industry. SAMR requires an actual, leased or owned premises within the municipal registration district; tax authorities require the premises to be the place where accountants and books are kept; banks reject any application that does not permit an on-site visit and verification of a physical desk, signboard and staff. A serviced office or business center that offers a dedicated physical workstation and real meeting space may pass scrutiny, but a mere registered address or commercial mailbox is rejected. This is particularly strict for medium-risk enhanced due diligence under ISIC 4669.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High - approximately 70% probability of an unannounced inspection within the first 12 months. Checklist inspected: corporate signboard matches registered name; lease/ownership deeds and payment records; physical occupancy/employees; actual recordkeeping and business files; compliance with fire safety and storage requirements; VAT invoices and supplier/customer contracts; bank statements and SWIFT LC file; tax declaration consistency; utility bills; inventory or logistics agreements for petrochemicals.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAMR business registration and company name self-declaration filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation / local Administration for Market Regulation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: zero official fee under State Council Decree No. 734 and Decree No. 746; electronic filing is free.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Foreign investor corporate bundle notarization and legalization (apostille or consular)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-country notary public, apostille competent authority, PRC Embassy/Consulate, certified translation agency
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: notarization USD 50-150 per instrument; apostille USD 30-100 per instrument; consular legalization USD 50-150 per instrument; certified Chinese translation USD 30-80 per page.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PRC legal counsel due diligence and preparation of WFOE constitutional documents, board resolutions and UBO register
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard WFOE incorporation with AML/CFT and UBO compliance; no statutory tariff for private legal fees in PRC.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial owner information filing and initial AML/CFT compliance manual
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: PRC compliance consultant or law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 UBO declaration, risk assessment and training manual for medium-risk wholesale distribution.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Physical registered office setup: rental deposit and first month operating lease in a serviced business center
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial landlord / licensed real-estate leasing entity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing commercial market rate for a 20-40 sqm serviced office in a city center business district, always including security deposit and first month rent; exact rate is location-dependent.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank account pre-onboarding and SWIFT LC documentation support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: PRC corporate service provider (not the bank)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for assisting with banking interview, KYC collection, LC template review and foreign exchange registration preparation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2018 Amendment), particularly Articles 6, 7, 11, 23, 24, 29, 32, 37, 46, 49, 50 and 70; together with the Regulations on Registration Administration of Market Entities and the Provisions on the Administration of Foreign-Invested Enterprises (Foreign Investment Law of the PRC, effective January 1, 2020, Articles 2, 4, 16, 17, 18, 21, 27 and 30)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and its local affiliate, the Municipal Market Supervision and Administration Bureau / Administration for Market Regulation where the registered address is located; foreign investment filing is managed through the integrated platform of the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign Investment Enterprise Establishment Application Form and Articles of Association submitted through the SAMR online portal (National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System backup); the certificate of incorporation is the Unified Social Credit Code Business License (营业执照), with filing of the foreign investment information reported via the MOFCOM system
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. China maintains no statutory minimum registered capital for a WFOE limited liability company under current law; shareholders must subscribe to the amount stated in the Articles of Association, and capital contributions are governed by the subscribed capital contribution period in the Articles of Association (to be completed within such period as specified therein, not exceeding the maximum statutory period if applicable; no escrow block account is mandated by law, but committed capital must be declared and contributions evidenced for registration and later compliance with the Foreign Investment Information Reporting rules)

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-approval and Enterprise Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) online platform: National Enterprise Name Application System via the Integrated Market Regulation Portal at the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an application to reserve the Chinese name for the wholly foreign-owned enterprise. The proposed name must comply with Article 32 of the Regulations on Registration Administration of Market Entities and include the administrative division, distinct trade name, industry characteristic, and organizational form 'limited liability company'. Submit at least three alternative names, specify the intended business scope using the industry classification codes corresponding to wholesale distribution of plastic granules, and select 'foreign-invested enterprise' for review. The applicant shall upload the passport or identity document of the proposed legal representative, the foreign investor's company registration certificate authenticated as required, and the authorization letter. After preliminary approval, the name reservation notice is issued electronically and is valid for six months. If any name component contains prohibited characters or conflicts with existing similar trade names, the system will reject immediately. In such event the applicant should file new alternatives and, where a conflict is suspected, file a formal opposition cure via the SAMR administrative reconsideration window within five working days of the notice of refusal.
required_dossiers: Completed enterprise name pre-approval application form
Foreign investor incorporation certificate and apostilled copy (for common law jurisdiction) or notarized copy if not apostille
Passport copy of the proposed legal representative
Power of attorney signed by the foreign investor appointing the formation agent
Letter of commitment on authenticity and legality of submitted documents
Details of the proposed business scope including ISIC 4669/NAICS 424690 description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is queried or rejected, the applicant may resubmit using the same portal after curing the rejection notes; if the rejection is based on a substantive conflict with a prior registered name, the applicant may file a written challenge with the local Administration for Market Regulation administrative reconsideration unit within five working days, submitting prior rights evidence and a rationale for distinctiveness.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Formation Documents and Foreign Investment Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System and local notary office for certified copies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and formally execute the Articles of Association, the Shareholders' Decision or Investment Agreement, and the joint venture contract if applicable. The documents must be executed in Chinese by all shareholders and directors, with each signature either witnessed before a registered notary or verified by the signature of the foreign investor's notarial agency in the jurisdiction of origin. After execution, submit the foreign investment information through the MOFCOM Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System; the submission must identify the foreign investor, the exact proposed capital contribution amount, the settlement and payment sources, and the ultimate beneficial ownership chain. The filing shall be completed before or simultaneously with the market entity registration, but in practice the platform allows a filing confirmation number to be issued after registration; the information must be entered within thirty days after obtaining the business license. Any discrepancy between the capital contribution date and the bank receipts must be raised in the filing platform's supplementary data window. Where the foreign investor is subject to national security review under the Foreign Investment Law, the parties must confirm the review application has been made or that no review is required because the wholesale distribution activity is outside the restricted sectors.
required_dossiers: Notarized or apostilled foreign investor corporate documents
Power of attorney for the local formation agent
Pro-forma Articles of Association in Chinese execution form
Reserved enterprise name approval certificate
Declaration of actual control and ultimate beneficiary information
No objection letter from the foreign investor's board if the investing company is outside China
Foreign Investment Information Report form completed in the MOFCOM system
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the foreign investment filing is returned for incomplete beneficial ownership information, the applicant must correct and resubmit the filing platform input within five working days; if the submission is suspended for national security review potential, the applicant may provide a written legal opinion that the activity falls within the wholesale distribution permitted category and request an expedited determination in accordance with the Interim Measures for National Security Review of Foreign Investment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Registration with Market Supervision Administration and Business License Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Registration Service Window or online registration via the National 'One-Window' Platform for Foreign Investment Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the registration application to the relevant district/municipal SAMR using Form R (Enterprise Registration Application) as established under the Measures for the Registration of Foreign-Invested Enterprises. The application must be accompanied by the executed articles of association, the lease agreement for the proposed registered office with the property ownership certificate of the landlord, and resolutions of the shareholder and the first board of directors if a board is convened. The system will verify the registered capital amount and the paid-in schedule. The legal representative and supervisor must provide their personal identification and the legal representative must provide proof of address. The registration official will review the documents for compliance with the negative list; if the enterprise is in the wholesale distribution of petrochemical polymers, the sector is open to foreign investment, so no special approval is required, only the standard registration. After acceptance, SAMR issues the Unified Social Credit Code Business License; concurrently the enterprise obtains access to the national enterprise credit information publicity system and the tax, customs, statistical, social insurance, and labor registration records will be created automatically via data sharing. The license must be collected personally or by the authorized agent at the service window; the original documents and stamp-owner identity are verified at collection.
required_dossiers: Enterprise establishment application form signed by the legal representative
Approved Articles of Association in Chinese
Registered office lease agreement plus the landlord's certificate of titled ownership or property ownership certificate
Certificate of capital contribution capability or bank letter of deposit if the capital is to be paid in full at registration (optional but commonly required by some registrations)
Shareholders' certificate of incorporation for foreign investor and notarized translations
Identification documents of the legal representative, supervisor, and general manager
Foreign investment filing confirmation number obtained after MOFCOM submission (where available as pre-registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is queried for discrepancies in the registered address, the legal representative's eligibility, or the trade name, the applicant may resubmit corrections in the same application within three working days; if the SAMR issues a written refusal, the applicant may apply for reconsideration to the same agency within sixty days under the Administrative Reconsideration Law and thereafter institute administrative litigation before the relevant people's court within fifteen days of receiving the reconsideration decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration Tax, Customs, Foreign Exchange, Seal and Social Security Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Taxation Administration (local tax service hall), General Administration of Customs (local customs office), State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE through designated bank), Public Security Bureau Seal-Engraving Filing Unit, and local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty calendar days after obtaining the business license, complete the following statutory integrations: (a) tax registration and assessment through the electronic tax bureau, obtaining the taxpayer identification number from the business license and completing the enrolment of accounting system and invoicing limits for the wholesale trading operation; (b) foreign exchange settlement registration through the bank with which the basic deposit account is opened, reporting the WFOE capital account details; (c) customs registration only if import/export licenses are later required; however, for wholesale distribution using letters of credit, the entity must open a foreign currency current account and file the Foreign Exchange Registration with SAFE, followed by receipt of foreign exchange settlement eligibility; (d) engraving the company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal, and invoice seal at a licensed seal-engraving establishment, and filing the seal imprints with the local Public Security Bureau; (e) reconciling social insurance, medical insurance, and housing fund registrations so as not to have later operational penalties; and (f) if the company leases premises engaged in warehousing, applying for the fire-fighting and building-use permit inspection as part of subsequent licensing (not required at this step but initiated here). Any foreign exchange transaction in relation to capital contribution requires the bank to inspect the capital verification evidence; the directors should therefore open the bank account as per the board resolution and deposit the capital before the agreed subscription date.
required_dossiers: Business license (Unified Social Credit Code Certificate)
Articles of Association and board resolution approving bank countersignature authority
Legal representative identification and confirmation of chief financial officer
Bank account opening certificate/provisional receipt for basic deposit account
Seal-engraving permission application form and the six-party commitment letter
Mailing address, contact numbers, and site layout for fire inspection notification if the premises include storage areas
Foreign exchange registration form and capital payment schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any registration fails (e.g., tax registration flags a suspicious legal representative history or social security ID mismatch), the remedy is to present the SAMR business license and the individual's valid ID to the relevant counter in person; if the failure concerns foreign exchange registration, the bank may require an updated SAFE form through the digital SAFE portal and the company should apply for rectification in writing. If an administrative penalty is threatened for late registration, the company may invoke the relevant discretionary rules for newly established enterprises, but must cure the missing registration within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Physical Site and Industrial Licensing Clearance Pre-filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local District Emergency Management Bureau (Civil Defense/Fire and Rescue Section), Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau (EPB), and District Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission for building-use classification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Given that the business scope covers wholesale distribution of virgin polyethylene and polypropylene granules with potential storage of bulk polymer pellets, the company must classify its premises under the relevant industrial licensing matrix. Before any commercial operations from the registered office and before the first import cargo is bond-stored, the company's environmental health and safety manager must conduct a site audit consisting of: an evaluation of whether the warehouse area exceeds the exempt storage capacity thresholds; mapping of chemical storage compatibility and identification of fire risk category under the Civil Defense fire design codes; confirmation that the premises are designated by the local urban planning authority as commercial/wholesale trade rather than manufacturing. If the premises contain no processing, no chemical reaggregation, no heated extrusion or re-pelletizing, and no hazardous waste generation, the facility may qualify for the 'Environmental Registration Exempt' tier; where the facility stores polymers that are not listed hazardous chemicals and only mechanical handling occurs, the authority requires a simple civil defense fire safety self-inspection report and a fire-fighting acceptance filing. However, if any blending or compounding operation is later added, a full environmental impact assessment report might be required; the company should therefore file a descriptive site notification with the Ecology and Environment Bureau confirming there is no chemical reaction or solvent handling activity. This filing may also be attached to the business license registration by means of a supplementary exhibition checklist.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement and floor plan of all storage spaces
Material safety data sheets (MSDS) for virgin polyethylene and polypropylene pellets and any associated masterbatch additives
Fire safety design statement prepared by a registered fire-safety services technician
Environmental self-declaration of no hazardous wastewater or VOC-emitting operations
If any grinding/communition is intended: emission control equipment specification and preliminary environmental assessment documentation; otherwise a declaration of exemption
Civil defense acceptance filing form for the premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the emergency management bureau classifies the site as requiring a fire safety acceptance certificate due to the quantity of stored plastic pellet inventory exceeding the exempt threshold, the applicant must commission a certified fire safety evaluation and submit the design rectification for review within ten working days. If the ecology bureau mandates an environmental registration rather than the claimed exemption, the applicant may submit the exemption argument based on the inert nature of bulk PE/PP pellets and the absence of washing, melting, or reprocessing; where the bureau insists on registration, the company must complete the simplified 'Environmental Assessment Registration Form' within five days of the request.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Industry/Commerce License Division, in coordination with the local Emergency Management Bureau (fire and civil defense) and the Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau; the industrial authority for trade-only wholesale is the district commerce bureau (DCO) for commercial registration of wholesale distribution, and the General Administration of Customs applies for cross-border trade compliance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License with registered business scope including 'Wholesale of Plastic Raw Materials (in bulk)', together with a separate 'Fire Safety Inspection Certificate' where the warehouse section stores all polymer pellets, and an 'Environmental Registration Certificate' where applicable; for pure trading without warehousing no industrial manufacturing operation license is required

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau (Environmental Protection Agency of the People's Republic of China at the local level)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration or Exempt for pure wholesale and bulk transfer with no processing: the activity constitutes ISIC 4669 wholesale trade (Class III in environmental classification for non-manufacturing commerce). Since there is no chemical conversion, no melting, no solvent use, and no wastewater discharge, the project is rated 'Exempt' per the 2021 Classification of Environmental Impact Assessment for Construction Projects (Ministry of Ecology and Environment Catalogue); if the company later installs mechanical pellet conveying and bagging equipment with dust filtration, it is classified as 'Environmental Registration (fill-in-form)' under Category PP (wholesale and trade services), which can be submitted online and approved immediately. Full Environmental Impact Report is Not applicable for wholesale trading without manufacturing; however, if the same site will warehouse more than the local exempt quantity and is adjacent to residential areas, the local bureau may require a restricted-level 'EIA Registration Form with an after-action monitoring report for dust and noise'.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The facility shall not discharge any industrial wastewater except sanitary sewage connected to the municipal sewer system. Wastewater quality must meet the Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard (GB 8978-1996) Table 1 (COD ≤ 500 mg/L for indirect discharge to municipal sewer, pH 6-9, suspended solids ≤ 400 mg/L) unless the local municipal sewer agreement contains stricter terms. VOCs: no organic solvent use is permitted; any trace volatile emissions from pellet surfaces are not controlled, but if a hot-air dryer or extruder is added the facility must comply with the Comprehensive Emission Standard for Air Pollutants (GB 16297-1996) ceiling limits (non-methane total hydrocarbons ≤ 120 mg/m3 at exhaust height 15 m) and the local Implementation of the National Air Pollution Prevention Law requirements. Hazardous waste handling: if waste oil from mechanical conveyor gearboxes is generated (code HW08), the WFOE must register as a hazardous waste generator, maintain hazardous waste storage within one year in sealed containers, and deliver the waste to a licensed disposal unit; manifest forms must be submitted through the national solid waste information system. If no hazardous waste is generated, the company must also fulfill the annual solid waste declaration and maintain a minimization plan.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety: the registered office and any associated warehouse must obtain the Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate or, for facilities below the statutory threshold, a filing (recordation) of fire safety self-inspection in accordance with the Fire Protection Law of the PRC (2019 amendment). The premises must pass the fire-resistance rating for warehouse class I or II, with fire extinguishers configured at the density of one 4-kg ABC type unit per 75 m2, automatic sprinkler protection if the plastic pellet warehouse storage area exceeds 300 m2, emergency evacuation exits present, and clear aisle widths of no less than 1.4 m. Structural load: the building management certificate from the Urban-Rural Development Commission must confirm a floor load rating of not less than 0.5 ton/m2 for wholesale storage; if palletized polymer pellets (nominal 25 kg bags or octabins) exceed this load, the operator must complete strengthening design review and work-conservation acceptance. Occupationally, the company must complete occupational hazard declaration under the Work Safety Law of the PRC and conduct a baseline workplace occupational hazard detection for noise and respirable particulates in manually-operated bagging areas; hearing protection must be provided if noise exceeds 85 dB(A) and dust control measures if PM10 exceeds 150 µg/m3 as an 8-hour TWA. The civil defense permit is issued by the district Emergency Management Bureau after the fire-safety design review has been accepted; this clearance must be renewed after any modification of routeing, rededicated storage, or change of building ownership.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic filing and registration are performed through the STA Electronic Tax Bureau e-Tax portal (https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn), with the central public information portal at https://www.chinatax.gov.cn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The WFOE is incorporated in mainland China as a Chinese resident legal person, so it does not use a foreign non-resident tax registration path. It obtains its statutory Tax Identification Number through the registration integration procedure: (1) the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) issues the business license with an 18-character Uniform Social Credit Code (USCC); (2) the USCC is automatically transmitted to the STA as the unified taxpayer identifier for VAT, Enterprise Income Tax, stamp duty and all other tax filings; (3) if automatic tax registration is not completed, the legal representative must complete tax registration through the STA Electronic Tax Bureau within 30 days of business license issuance, providing the business license, articles of association, legal representative identity document, registered-address proof, bank account information and accounting records; (4) a separate TIN/VAT ID number is not issued because the USCC is the single tax code. For a foreign non-resident entity with China-source income but no registered Chinese establishment, the foreign entity or its Chinese withholding agent completes non-resident tax information registration with the local STA office, supplying the home-country tax identification number and a certificate of tax residence; the STA then assigns a non-resident taxpayer master-file code for withholding, VAT and Enterprise Income Tax purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (resident WFOE taxed on worldwide income; no territorial exemption and no tax-exempt-zone classification)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None; China has no check-the-box, LLC pass-through, or hybrid mismatch elections for income tax. Only a VAT registration classification election exists: a below-threshold WFOE may voluntarily register as a general VAT taxpayer to claim input credits; otherwise it remains a small-scale taxpayer.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) of the People's Republic of China
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Basic tax registration is mandatory from the date of establishment with no turnover threshold; mandatory general VAT taxpayer registration is triggered when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000, while businesses at or below that threshold are small-scale taxpayers subject to the 3% levy rate (unless the general taxpayer election is exercised).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT invoices, including special and ordinary VAT invoices, must be issued through the STA-authorized Electronic Invoice Service Platform using the full digital electronic invoice (FDEI) mechanism integrated with the Golden Tax System; invoice data is transmitted to the tax authority in real time, each invoice receives an automatic digital tax-control stamp and unique invoice code, and no manual or offline billing is permitted outside the approved electronic clearance process.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The export of qualifying goods, including virgin polyethylene and polypropylene granules, is eligible for 0% VAT export zero-rating only if the goods are physically exported from mainland China under a valid customs export declaration, the sale is a genuine transfer of title to a non-resident overseas buyer at arm's length, the complete export documentation set is internally consistent, and the export proceeds are received through a Chinese-licensed bank within the statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline. The WFOE may then apply the export exemption-and-refund method to recover attributable input VAT on the exported petrochemical polymers.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bill of Entry) issued by China Customs after actual export clearance
Bill of Lading, sea waybill, air waybill or international consignment note evidencing physical movement of the goods out of mainland China
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list conforming exactly to the export declaration
Sales contract and export order specifying Incoterms, overseas buyer identity and payment terms
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or Chinese bank-issued export foreign-exchange receipt voucher recorded in the SAFE Service System for cross-border current-account receipts
VAT invoice, where applicable, issued through the STA e-invoice platform with the digital tax-control stamp
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA will audit the export file for document consistency, physical exit, counterparty substance, transfer-pricing integrity and timely repatriation of foreign exchange. Missing, inconsistent, or forged customs declarations, bills of lading, payment records, or FIRC-equivalent banking evidence will cause the export zero-rating to be withdrawn; the transaction will be recharacterized as a domestic taxable sale with 13% VAT assessed on the full export price, previously refunded input VAT will be clawed back with daily late-payment interest, and penalties ranging from 50% to five times the tax involved may be imposed in fraudulent or grossly negligent cases, with referral to criminal authorities for export VAT fraud under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China maintains a bifurcated foreign exchange system. Current account items are generally freely convertible, permitting trade-related payments and income remittances after simple documentary verification; however, capital account items were historically subject to strict quota-and-approval controls. For a WFOE engaged in wholesale petrochemical polymer distribution, operating profit and dividend remittance are classified under the current account and can be converted into USD/EUR at a licensed bank, provided the bank receives audited financial statements, tax payment certificates on profit remittance, and board resolution declaring the distribution. The capital account side remains controlled in respect of equity injection, external debt, and cross-border guarantees. All capital inflows under the FDI framework must be lodged into a designated capital foreign exchange settlement account and are subject to negative-list review and SAFE's payment-purpose checking. Repatriation of the original paid-in capital is possible only after lawful dissolution and a SAFE tax clawback certificate. Thus, convertibility is high for operational trade flows but not fully free for financial transactions; treasury planning must preserve a permanent documentary chain.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE's 2020 Measures for Administration of Trade in Goods FX, exporters must repatriate 100% of contract export proceeds to China and account for them through the Trade Monitoring System no later than 180 days after the customs export declaration date. There is no statutory mandatory conversion ratio; the exporter may voluntarily sell foreign exchange or retain the proceeds in a non-resident/foreign-currency settlement account until ready for CNY conversion. However, the target WFOE must comply with the 'collection verification' matching of Customs export data to bank receipts to avoid administrative penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI capital settlement) and Basic Operational Currency Account (USD/EUR/CNY)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Currency Account with Sub-ledger for Trade Proceeds
Capital Escrow Account and Dedicated RMB/FCY Corporate Current Account
Operational Currency Account – Export Receipts Settlement
Secondary Clearing Account for Trade Settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Viability is Low for all offshore digital EMIs. The People's Bank of China and SAFE only recognise licensed banks and bank-like financial institutions for opening corporate CNY and foreign currency accounts; standalone EMIs are not granted a banking licence in China. Foreign fintech EMIs may collaborate with a local bank but cannot provide settlement finality or hold the WFOE's funds independently. Domestic fintechs such as Alipay and WeChat Pay are payment tools, not account-holding institutions, and cannot satisfy SAFE's account host responsibility for corporate treasury. Therefore, the WFOE must rely on a tier-1 bank rail, using EMIs solely as payment initiation interfaces if the bank permits the API connection.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical in-branch appearance of the WFOE's legal representative or a designated board-appointed officer is generally mandatory at account opening. Remote consular proxy opening is available only with a notarised, apostilled and Chinese-translated power of attorney, followed by in-person confirmation during the bank's dedicated video call; however, most tier-1 banks retain the right to require a final in-branch signature on the account bankability and segregation declaration. A statutory director cannot be fully exempted from some form of identification verification unless the bank's overseas branch performs a wholesale KYC exchange.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity in the offshore parent/holding chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate registry certificate of the direct shareholder, constitutional documents (articles and registers), notarised beneficial ownership declaration listing all natural persons with >10% stake, source of wealth statement, and cross-border shareholder resolution proving the funding chain; all documents must be legalised, apostilled, and translated into Chinese.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure arising from petrochemical counterparties or shipping/vessel fleets
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Screenshots of enhanced due diligence results from OFAC/EU/UN sanctions lists, executed KYC packs on all trading partners, certificates of origin and bills of lading showing lawful supply chain, International Maritime Organization vessel registration and flag state documents, and a written self-certification that no product is transshipped to a sanctioned country; plus customs clearance records from China Customs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FDI capital injected via fiduciary or third-party jurisdiction with currency denomination mismatches
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investment board resolution, parent company auditor's signed financial statements for the last three years, source-of-funds letter from the remitting bank, beneficial owner passport copy, and a Chinese CPA-issued capital verification report after the inward remittance is fully settled.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch of declared business scope versus bank account usage (trading in bulk polymers)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid business licence with ISIC 4669 activities, contract portfolio evidencing the sale of PE/PP polymers, VAT registration certificate, warehouse receipt and transport insurance policies, and a treasury policy board minute confirming that all transactions are on real trade under the company's customs-bound commodity flow.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: FDI capital injection must utilise the approved SAFE foreign exchange settlement account under the bank's direct remittance rail. The remitter should wire via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code accurately described as 'FDI paid-in capital contribution'; the receiving bank then files capital account information through the SAFE digital system. The investor must complete the FDI Admittance Form and obtain a capital verification confirmation from a Chinese certified public accountant. After conversion into RMB, funds are earmarked under the negative-list system and can only be disbursed on a 'real use' basis to pay suppliers, wages, or purchase of goods/services permitted by the business scope.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For cross-border settlement, the WFOE should use (i) telegraphic transfers via SWIFT MT103 for small-value and revolving open-account payments; (ii) irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued and advised through SWIFT MT700/MT707 for pre-export or purchase-side finance, with the beneficiary's presentation of compliant shipping documents; (iii) documentary collections D/P and D/A via correspondent banks for moderate-risk trade. Domestic CNY payments should be run through CNAPS and cross-border RMB through CIPS, complying with SAFE's trade authenticity review. Ensure every outward remittance has a valid customs declaration code and underlying trade contract.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Corporate foreign currency forward contracts (deliverable) for hedging trade receivables and payables
Foreign exchange swaps for temporary liquidity transformation between CNY and foreign currency
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for long-term debt service matching under SAFE-Eligibility
Zero-premium option structures (e.g., knock-in/knock-out forwards) provided they hedge real exposure and pass the bank's suitability review

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report Filing to the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), including the Foreign Investment Information Report required under the PRC Foreign Investment Law
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation at the WFOE's registered address, filed electronically via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of each calendar year, covering the preceding fiscal year. New WFOEs file a first annual report for the stub period from incorporation to December 31 of the incorporation year; no proration deadline exists.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If not filed by June 30, the WFOE is placed on the Operation Exception List; if unremedied for three consecutive years, the WFOE is added to the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List, leading to joint disciplinary actions, administrative revocation of business license, restriction of the legal representative and director, and interruption of tax, customs, and foreign exchange conveniences. False or omitted reporting is subject to an administrative fine of RMB 5,000-20,000 (approx. USD 690-2,760).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Settlement and Payment (annual tax return reconciliation of taxable income)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent local office of the State Taxation Administration (STA) / tax service bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 in the year following each tax year. Quarterly interim prepayments remain due within 15 days after each quarter-end; the annual filing deadline is non-extendable without a formal application.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to RMB 2,000 (approx. USD 276), and RMB 2,000-10,000 (approx. USD 276-1,380) for serious late filing; overdue tax is subject to a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid amount; an understated tax liability triggers a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax; deliberate tax evasion may lead to criminal prosecution, bank account freezing, VAT invoice quota revocation, and loss of tax clearance certificates required for SWIFT/LC transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Registration Change Filing for shareholders, directors, registered capital, and constitution documents (event-driven; annual confirmation embedded in SAMR report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) for registration; State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through designated banks for foreign currency capital changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: All facts affecting registered items, including equity transfers and director changes, must be filed with SAMR within 30 days of the event. The annual confirmation of ultimate shareholding is filed with the SAMR annual report by June 30.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Untimely filing of a registration change attracts a warning and a fine on the company up to RMB 10,000 (approx. USD 1,380); the legal representative or directly responsible officers may be fined RMB 1,000-5,000 (approx. USD 138-690). Persistent non-compliance causes the change to be unenforceable against third parties, restricts dividends/remittances, and is treated as a UBO transparency breach under PRC anti-money laundering rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Exchange and Direct Investment Statistics Report (Capital Project Information System) covering cross-border equity, loans, and branch balances
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) via the WFOE's settlement bank or directly through SAFE's ASOne Capital Project Information System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by June 30 for the preceding calendar year, aligned with the SAMR annual report; quarterly foreign debt (external loan) balance reports are due within 5 working days after each quarter-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-reporting or misreporting can result in suspension or blocking of the WFOE's foreign exchange receipt/payment activities, a fine of RMB 10,000-300,000 (approx. USD 1,380-41,400) under the PRC Foreign Exchange Control Regulations, and placement on SAFE's non-compliant corporate list, which disrupts SWIFT LC settlement and irrevocable letter of credit transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: PRC law imposes mandatory annual independent audit on every wholly foreign-owned enterprise (WFOE) because the PRC Company Law, the Accounting Law, and the Implementation Rules of the Accounting Law classify a foreign-invested limited liability company as a mandatory audited entity; therefore no quantitative turnover or asset minimum is applicable to exempt a WFOE. For the benefit of risk calibration, the same legal framework also requires a mandatory audit where any of the following quantitative benchmarks is exceeded: balance sheet total assets above RMB 50,000,000 (approx. USD 6,900,000); annual net business revenue above RMB 30,000,000 (approx. USD 4,200,000) for a wholesale trading enterprise; or permanent headcount above 300 employees. In all cases, the audit must be performed by an independent PRC-certified public accounting firm in accordance with Chinese Auditing Standards and the certified financial statements must be submitted to SAMR/SAFE and tax authorities where required.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE/CAS) issued by the Ministry of Finance, substantially converged with IFRS. A WFOE in the bulk petrochemical wholesale trade does not qualify for the Simplified Small Enterprise Accounting System and must apply full ASBE/CAS. The annual CIT reconciliation additionally requires tax-basis adjustments based on PRC tax rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: PRC company law mandates a shareholder register; the WFOE must update this register within 30 days of any transfer. There is no standalone annual UBO return; however, the annual SAMR/Foreign Investment Information Report requires confirmation of the ultimate investor and actual controller as of the year-end, and any change in the direct or indirect shareholding must be disclosed to SAMR within the 30-day change-registration window. In addition, the PRC Anti-Money Laundering Rules and the Law on Business Information Disclosure require the company to keep an internal beneficial ownership record that is refreshed no less frequently than annually and confirmed by the legal representative and board.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: China's statutory CIT rate is 25%. Preferential rates may reduce the effective burden: 15% for certified High-Tech Enterprises; an effective 5% rate for Small and Low-Profit Enterprises on taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million; 100% super deduction for qualified R&D expenses (200% deduction). Petrochemical wholesale trading WFOEs generally do not benefit from free-zone incentives unless located in designated bonded/free-trade pilot zones with specific local preferential rules.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Annual Return, Form A (中华人民共和国企业所得税年度纳税申报表A类), filed electronically through eTax@CHINATAX (electronic tax bureau portal).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual settlement with quarterly provisional CIT prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly provisional returns and payments are due within 15 days after each calendar quarter-end. The annual CIT return is due within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, i.e. generally by May 31 for the preceding calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating revenue from wholesale sales of virgin polyethylene and polypropylene granules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all China-sourced gross sales revenue derived from bulk polymer resale. For a WFOE acting as a limited-risk distributor, ensure the gross margin is arm's length and consistent with the transfer pricing documentation. Do not net intercompany commissions or rebates against revenue unless approved and supported by contracts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating cost, primarily cost of goods sold for imported and domestically procured polymer granules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Match COGS with the applicable inventory valuation method (e.g. weighted average or FIFO). If purchases are made from overseas related parties, verify that the per-tonne pricing equals a CUP or aligns with the transfer pricing study. Recharacterization of inflated import prices may trigger CIT adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxes and surcharges, excluding CIT and VAT, such as urban maintenance and construction tax and education surcharges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure VAT-excluded figures are used. Customs duties and non-deductible VAT penalties must be excluded. Any sales tax or levy borne by the WFOE on behalf of an overseas principal is not deductible unless contractually ring-fenced and substantiated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses, including logistics, freight, marine insurance, warehousing, and sales commissions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border freight and insurance must be separately itemized. Payments to overseas agents must satisfy the beneficial ownership test and be commercially justified. Excessive marketing fees to related offshore entities will be scrutinized as disguised profit repatriation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative expenses, including management fees, headquarters cost allocations, rent, and professional fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany management fees are deductible only if the recipient provides actual services and the charge passes the benefit test. A foreign parent cannot simply impose a blanket profit-collection 'management fee' on the WFOE. Such payments are frequently recharacterized as dividends or nondeductible distributions under China's transfer pricing rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Finance costs, including interest expense on bank borrowings and intercompany shareholder loans.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to non-resident shareholders is deductible only within the statutory thin capitalization ratio: generally 2:1 debt-to-equity for non-financial enterprises and 5:1 for financial enterprises. The portion exceeding the ratio is disallowed and may be recharacterized as a deemed dividend subject to 10% withholding tax. Beneficial ownership of interest must be documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment income, including dividends received from domestic subsidiaries and other equity-sourced income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received by a Chinese resident enterprise from another domestic resident enterprise are generally exempt CIT. For foreign-sourced dividends, assess whether China's foreign tax credit applies. Ensure Form and underlying computations are retained for credits claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating income, including government subsidies, penalties recovered, and foreign exchange gains.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Subsidies received from Chinese local governments may be taxable unless included in a tax-exempt policy list. Forex gains are taxable; ensure intercompany accounts are revalued at the official exchange rate at year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating expenses, including donations, asset write-offs, and casualty losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only charitable donations through approved channels are deductible within the 12% of annual profit cap. Administrative penalties, bribes, and unauthorized write-offs are not deductible. Game the film? No. Keep strict documentary evidence for each write-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total accounting profit before CIT (operating profit plus investment income plus non-operating income minus non-operating expenses).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This amount must reconcile exactly to the audited financial statements. For WFOEs, the audit report should incorporate transfer pricing adjustments consistent with the Local File. Any material difference triggers tax bureau inquiries.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after tax adjustments: accounting profit adjusted by all tax preference items, recent-year loss carryforwards, and CIT adjustment schedules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply all relevant adjustments: nondeductible expenses under CITA Art. 10, transfer pricing adjustments, thin capitalization disallowances, and loss carryforwards (maximum 5 years, except certain high-tech/SME rules permitting 10 years). Prepare a robust bridge from accounting profit to taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable CIT rate: normally 25%, or preferential 15%/20% with legal certificates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A WFOE engaged in wholesale trading is unlikely to qualify as a High-Tech Enterprise if no qualifying R&D activity is performed. Claiming the 15% HITE rate without valid certification creates a criminal evasion exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT liability computed as taxable income multiplied by the applicable rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recalculate for quarterly prepayments. Disregard any foreign withholding tax credits until shown in Box 14.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign income tax credit for taxes paid abroad on overseas-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a Chinese WFOE receiving dividends from a foreign subsidiary, the foreign tax credit is limited to the amount of Chinese tax payable on the same foreign-source income. Maintain foreign tax returns, assessments, and TRCs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Actual annual CIT payable before deducting provisional prepayments (Box 13 minus Box 14).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE derives no foreign-source income, Box 14 will be zero. Do not offset outbound withholding tax obligations against the company's own CIT liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly provisional CIT prepayments already made during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All four quarterly voucher numbers and payment dates must be recorded. Missing or delayed prepayments attract daily surcharges and late-filing penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance due or refund: Box 15 minus Box 16.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any balance is payable upon filing. A refund claim automatically triggers tax bureau review. For a WFOE, a consistent refund position over multiple years signals aggressive planning and increases audit selection.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of CIT returns may result in a penalty of up to RMB 2,000 for ordinary cases, rising to RMB 10,000 if the tax authority has issued liens or warnings. Late payment of tax accrues daily surcharge at 0.05% of the unpaid tax (15.25% per annum). Under the Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63, intentional under-declaration or false filing is treated as tax evasion and punished with 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax. If criminal tax evasion is established under Criminal Law Article 201, fines and imprisonment (up to 7 years for large amounts) apply.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on outbound dividends paid by a Chinese resident enterprise to its non-resident corporate shareholder, unless reduced by an applicable Double Tax Agreement (DTA).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from its home jurisdiction tax authority, supply a certificate of beneficial ownership (Form and supporting board resolutions/contracts), and complete the withholding tax reduction/refund procedure at the Chinese payer's competent tax bureau prior to remittance or, in approved cases, through a refund claim after tax withheld. The non-resident must show that it is the beneficial owner of the dividends, that the shareholding meets the treaty threshold (commonly at least 25% participation for a reduced 5% dividend rate), and that the arrangement has genuine commercial substance. The e-tax withholding report must be filed within the statutory remittance timeline; late filing triggers surcharges and penalties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory WHT 10%; many DTA treaties reduce to 5% (e.g. mainland treaties with Hong Kong, Singapore under certain conditions), while certain treaties keep 10% or impose citation-specific conditions. Interest: statutory WHT 10%; DTA rates commonly 5%, 7%, or 10% depending on the treaty partner and the lender's status (e.g. financial institution exemption or reduced rate). Payments to related offshore collectors must demonstrate beneficial ownership; pure conduit arrangements are denied treaty benefits.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under SAT Public Notice [2016] No. 42, a Local File must be maintained by a Chinese controlled taxpayer in any fiscal year where related-party tangible property transfers reach or exceed RMB 200 million; related-party intangible property transfers or financial-asset transfers reach or exceed RMB 100 million; or other related-party transactions reach or exceed RMB 40 million. A Master File may also be required if the global ultimate parent prepares one or if the Chinese enterprise meets statutory turnover/related-party transaction thresholds.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not impose a separate Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) filing similar to some offshore financial centers; however, substantive economic activities are embedded in the general anti-avoidance rule under CITA Article 47 and in treaty benefit entitlement. A WFOE distributing bulk petrochemical polymers must demonstrate that it performs real functions (e.g. procurement negotiation, inventory risk, logistics, credit risk, and Chinese market development), owns or controls relevant assets, and employs qualified personnel in China. Lacking CIGA in China would expose intercompany cross-border flows to recharacterization, denial of treaty benefits, and penalty.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately understating wholesale revenue from polymer sales, inflating imported pellet costs, using fake VAT invoices, or manufacturing false books to shift taxable profit to an offshore related entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63: monetary penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax, plus daily late-payment interest. Criminal Law Article 201: criminal tax evasion conviction attracts a fine and imprisonment of up to 7 years where the evaded amount is substantial.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts and tax authorities may pierce the corporate veil where the WFOE is a mere facade or assets are commingled with shareholder personal assets. Directors who ordered, approved, or participated in the evasion face personal civil liability to the tax authority and to creditors; the legal representative may be placed on the exit-ban (blacklisting) system preventing overseas travel until taxes are settled. Senior officers face criminal detention or imprisonment and are disqualified from acting as directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling polyethylene and polypropylene granules to a related offshore distributor at prices far below arm's length CUP, paying excessive management fees to the foreign parent, and deducting interest on shareholder debt beyond the statutory 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CITA Articles 41 and 46 authorize tax authorities to make a transfer-pricing adjustment to taxable income. The excessive-interest expense is disallowed and may be recharacterized as a deemed dividend subject to 10% withholding tax. Sanctions under Tax Collection Administration Law apply for underpayment of tax, including interest and penalties up to 50% to 500% of unpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign transfer-pricing documentation or knowingly approve non-arm's length transactions can be held jointly and severally liable to the company and tax authority for resulting tax shortfalls where bad faith or misconduct is proved. Exit controls, asset freezes, and blacklisting may attach to the legal representative. In serious cases involving forged intercompany agreements, criminal fraud or tax evasion charges can extend to individual directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Treaty Shopping / Shell Company Substance Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Inserting a conduit company in Hong Kong, Singapore, or an offshore jurisdiction that holds the WFOE's equity or receives dividends/interest/royalties solely to invoke a reduced DTA withholding rate, without any local office, staff, business operations, or genuine ownership control.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: China's GAAR under CITA Article 47 empowers the tax authority to disregard the conduit entity and recharacterize the transaction. Treaty benefits are denied; the statutory 10% WHT is re-imposed with daily late penalties and potential underpayment penalties. For AML purposes, predicate tax evasion may trigger Financial Intelligence Unit reporting and asset seizure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who establish or maintain a sham conduit with no economic substance expose themselves to civil claims for restitution and to criminal prosecution for evasion or defrauding the tax authority. The legal representative of the WFOE may be placed on the tax-involved person blacklist, resulting in travel bans, credit restriction, and prohibition on high consumption. If the conduit's funds are diverted to personal accounts, directors may face personal civil asset tracing, forfeiture, and imprisonment.
